media_asset_references_owner_valid.name: media_asset_references_owner_valid
media_asset_references_owner_valid.value:
(
    ("media_asset_references"."owner_type" = 'portfolio_project' AND "media_asset_references"."portfolio_project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_asset_references"."showreel_id" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("media_asset_references"."owner_type" = 'showreel' AND "media_asset_references"."portfolio_project_id" IS NULL AND "media_asset_references"."showreel_id" = 'singleton:showreel')
  )

media_assets_url_bounded.name: media_assets_url_bounded
media_assets_url_bounded.value: "media_assets"."url" IS NULL OR char_length("media_assets"."url") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048

hero_description.name: hero_description
hero_description.default: 'I turn raw footage into powerful stories that engage, inspire, and leave a lasting impact.'

footer_description.name: footer_description
footer_description.default: 'I transform ideas and raw footage into powerful visual stories that engage, inspire and leave a lasting impact.'
